accounting_contract.availability_rule: NSE exchange dissemination timestamp must be less than or equal to the historical information cutoff

comparison_protocol.matched_baseline_definition: Run unchanged Baseline V1 on exactly the Research V2 eligible stocks within each historical sector
comparison_protocol.performance_comparison: Research V2 versus matched Baseline V1 only
comparison_protocol.prohibited_comparison: Full/original Baseline rank versus Research V2 rank as a performance statistic
comparison_protocol.research_v2_cohort: Stocks eligible for Research V2 on the applicable historical ranking date

evaluation.baseline_signal_orientation: negative Baseline V1 score so higher is better; the underlying Baseline calculation is unchanged

primary.aggregate: equal-weight arithmetic mean across valid sector-date observations
primary.comparison: mean of Research V2 Rank IC minus matched Baseline V1 Rank IC over paired valid sector-date observations
primary.research_v2_signal_orientation: Research V2 score, higher is better

metrics: sample standard deviation of Rank IC
unannualized Rank ICIR when at least two valid observations exist and sample standard deviation is nonzero
top-ranked-stock excess return versus matched sector cohort
equal-sized top-half minus bottom-half future-return spread with the middle stock omitted for odd cohort sizes
Research V2 win/tie/loss count relative to matched Baseline V1

fingerprint.canonicalization: UTF-8 encoding of the parsed JSON value serialized with lexicographically sorted object keys, no insignificant whitespace, and separators ',' and ':'

future_return_labels.adjusted_price_semantics: Yahoo Adj Close endpoint divided by Yahoo Adj Close on the ranking date minus one
future_return_labels.endpoint_rule: Last trading observation on or before the calendar target horizon date
future_return_labels.missing_endpoint_policy: Exclude the label and report the exact missing-label reason
future_return_labels.outcome_isolation: No future-return label may influence predictor construction, eligibility, parameters, formulas, or weights

historical_universe.historical_sector_source: Corresponding official historical NSE Indices monthly snapshot
historical_universe.membership_rule: Official NIFTY 50 membership in the July Market Capitalisation, Weightage, Beta report preceding or containing the ranking date
historical_universe.source: Official NSE Indices Market Capitalisation, Weightage, Beta July monthly reports

special_identity_rules.action: Preserve in source provenance but exclude from investable ranking membership
special_identity_rules.reason: Official synthetic corporate-action placeholder, not yet a normally listed/tradable security

immutable_model_boundaries.baseline_v1: Existing accepted formulas, eligibility, anchors, ranking, and tie behavior
immutable_model_boundaries.research_v2: Existing accepted nine metrics, weights, directions, eligibility, rank-range normalization, final scoring, ranking, and ties

limitations: Yahoo historical prices are acquired retrospectively and are not vendor-vintage archives.
Yahoo adjusted-price semantics are inherited from accepted prior milestones.
Annual-report archive completeness may reduce historical Research V2 coverage.
Missing NSE dissemination timestamps cause exclusion.
Historical symbol or name changes may cause identity-resolution exclusions.
Only four annual ranking dates are evaluated, so statistical power is limited.
There is no transaction-cost, portfolio-profitability, or investment-performance claim.
The comparison studies ranking quality and is not investment advice.

no_tuning_rule.exploratory_alternatives: Must be labelled exploratory and cannot replace the preregistered primary result
no_tuning_rule.if_baseline_wins: Report that result without changing the protocol

price_features.historical_eligibility: Existing accepted anchor, tolerance, daily-return-count, and history rules
immutable_features: Baseline V1 days since recorded high

cutoff_rebased_adjusted_series.formula: pit_adjusted_price(s|t) = AdjClose(s) / (AdjClose(t) / Close(t)) for s <= t
cutoff_rebased_adjusted_series.purpose: Remove the common post-cutoff adjustment scale while preserving relative corporate-action-adjusted history through the cutoff
cutoff_rebased_adjusted_series.role: engineering normalization, not a stock-selection algorithm

price_predictor.donor: Yahoo historical prices through yfinance in the isolated market-data environment
